content: Good morning, beautiful. I woke up thinking about you. How was your night?
Morning! I slept okay. It's always nicer when I wake up to your messages.
That makes me so happy to hear. I wish I could be there to make you breakfast in bed. Soon, I hope.
I'd love that. It's been so long since anyone has done something sweet for me.
You deserve all the sweetness in the world. I keep thinking about sharing my life with you, especially now that my business opportunity is almost finalized.
What's happening with your business? You said there was some big news.
Yes! The contract is ready, but there's a snag. The lawyer says I need to pay a $2,000 processing fee before the funds are released. It's so frustrating having everything in limbo.
That sounds really stressful. Is there anything I can do?

You're so kind to ask. I hate to burden you, but if you could help with the fee, I could finish this deal and finally come visit. I promise to pay you back as soon as the funds clear, plus extra for your kindness.
I want to help, I just worry about my own bills. Are you sure everything is safe?

Absolutely. My lawyer is handling everything and I've seen all the documents. I would never put you at risk. Trust me, you mean too much to me. As soon as the contract is processed, we'll both celebrate.
Alright. What do I need to do?

Thank you, darling. Just send the amount to my Wise account using these details: Name: Mark T. Jensen, Account: 412976532, Routing: 021000021. Let me know once it's done so I can confirm with my lawyer right away.
I've never used Wise before. Is it easy?
It's very straightforward. Go to wise.com, create an account, and enter the payment details I sent. If you need help, I can walk you through it step by step.
Okay, I'll try to set it up after work. I really hope this helps you.
You have no idea how much this means to me. Once this is over, I'll be able to book my ticket and we can finally start our new life together.
That sounds wonderful. I just want things to work out for us.
They will, I promise. I wouldn't ask if it wasn't urgent. Trust me, we're so close to being together.
Alright, I'll message you when it's sent.
Thank you, my love. You're my angel. Let me know if you have any problems with Wise, I'm here for you.
